Epic, cinematic, sharp.

title: Chef's flambé close-up
prompt: Close-up of a chef's hands tilting a steel pan over a gas flame; the pan bursts into a big orange flambé that lights the chef's face from below. Busy restaurant kitchen blurred behind, steam and sparks in the air. Camera: static close-up, slight slow-motion as the flame rises. Warm contrasting light. Sound: sizzling, a whoosh of flame, kitchen clatter. Cinematic food film look.

title: Astronaut on Mars
prompt: An astronaut in a white spacesuit climbs to the top of a rocky red ridge on Mars and stops, looking out over a vast canyon under a hazy pink sky, dust blowing gently across the ground. Camera: low angle behind the astronaut, slow crane up over their shoulder to reveal the valley. Sound: the astronaut's breathing in the helmet, low wind. Realistic sci-fi film, 35mm look.

title: Old man on a train
prompt: An old man with a grey beard sits by the window of an old train carriage, holding a faded photo in his hands, looking out at green fields passing in late afternoon light. Light flickers across his face as trees pass. Camera: slow push-in from the opposite seat to a close-up of his face. Sound: rhythmic train wheels, quiet carriage. Emotional, gentle, film grain.

title: Ballerina in a spotlight
prompt: A ballerina in a white tutu spins in a single spotlight on an empty dark stage, dust drifting in the beam, her skirt flaring as she turns. Camera: slow 180-degree orbit around her at waist height. Soft haze, deep black background. Sound: a single piano melody, soft shoe taps on the wooden stage. Elegant, slow-motion feel, vertical 9:16.

title: Vintage car on a coast road
prompt: A red 1960s convertible drives along a winding cliff road above a turquoise sea on a sunny day, a couple inside with scarves blowing. Camera: drone shot alongside the car, slowly pulling away and up to show the coastline and a small white village ahead. Bright Mediterranean light, warm film colours. Sound: engine purr, wind, distant seagulls.

title: Old library in light
prompt: An old wooden library with tall bookshelves and a spiral staircase, afternoon sunbeams falling through high arched windows, dust floating in the light. A single reading lamp glows on a desk with an open book. Camera: slow smooth glide forward along the main aisle at eye level. Warm golden tones, quiet and magical, cinematic depth of field. Sound: soft clock ticking, pages rustling.

title: Perfume bottle orbit
prompt: A glass perfume bottle with pale pink liquid stands on a round mirror plinth against a soft beige backdrop. Camera: slow 360-degree orbit around the bottle over 8 seconds. A soft light moves across so highlights glide over the glass and the liquid glows. Tiny dust sparkles in the air. Sound: soft ambient pad. Luxury product ad, clean, vertical 9:16.

title: Sneaker drop with dust impact
prompt: A white high-top sneaker drops from above onto rough concrete and lands with a burst of dust that spreads out in slow motion. Camera: low static angle at ground level. Hard top light, dark grey background, crisp dust particles. Sound: deep thud, a whoosh of air. Bold sneaker ad, vertical 9:16.

title: Coffee pour macro
prompt: Macro close-up of cold milk pouring into a glass of iced coffee, swirling clouds forming between ice cubes in slow motion. Camera: static, very close, shallow depth of field. Bright window light from behind making the glass glow. Sound: soft pour, ice clinking. Fresh café ad, square 1:1.

title: Cream texture swirl
prompt: Extreme close-up of a small spatula scooping and swirling thick white face cream in an open glass jar, the texture forming soft peaks. Camera: slow push-in. Clean soft light, pale peach background, a few water droplets on the jar. Sound: soft creamy texture sounds, gentle music. Beauty ad, vertical 9:16.

title: Unboxing with hands
prompt: Top-down shot of hands opening a minimal white box on a light wooden desk: the lid lifts, tissue paper is pulled back and a pair of white wireless earbuds in their case is lifted out toward the camera. Camera: static overhead, then a slight push-in at the end. Soft daylight. Sound: cardboard sliding, tissue rustling, a soft click of the case. Satisfying unboxing, vertical 9:16.

title: POV morning routine
prompt: POV first-person shot: a hand turns off a phone alarm on a bedside table, then the view moves to a kitchen where the same hand pours coffee into a mug, then walks to a big window and opens the curtains to reveal a sunny city skyline. Smooth handheld POV with natural head movement. Bright soft morning light. Sound: alarm beep, coffee pouring, curtains sliding, birds outside. Aesthetic lifestyle reel, vertical 9:16.

title: Outfit change on a snap
prompt: A young woman stands in front of a mirror in a plain white t-shirt and jeans, looks at the camera and snaps her fingers. On the snap, a quick flash-cut changes her outfit to an elegant black evening dress with gold earrings, same pose, same room. Camera: static at chest height. Bright, clean bedroom light. Sound: a sharp finger snap and a bass drop. Fashion transition reel, vertical 9:16.

title: Street food hook shot
prompt: Extreme close-up of a street food vendor flipping a sizzling stuffed flatbread on a big hot griddle at a night market, oil bubbling, steam rising into the neon light, a cheese pull as it is cut in half and lifted toward the camera. Camera: quick push-in at the start, then static. Sound: loud sizzle, crowd chatter, a knife cutting. Mouth-watering food reel, vertical 9:16.

title: Talking head in a café
prompt: A friendly man in his late 20s with a short beard and a denim shirt sits at a café table and talks directly to the camera with natural hand gestures, smiling. He says: "Here are three AI tools I use every single day." Café blurred behind, soft window light. Camera: static selfie-style framing at eye level, slight handheld feel. Sound: his voice clear and close, soft café ambience. Creator reel, vertical 9:16.

title: Pet surprise reaction
prompt: A fluffy golden puppy sits on a living room rug looking up at the camera. A hand brings a squeaky toy into frame and the puppy's ears perk up, it tilts its head, then jumps and spins with excitement, tail wagging fast. Camera: low angle at the puppy's eye level, static. Warm home light. Sound: squeak, happy little barks. Funny pet reel, vertical 9:16.

title: Waterfall in the jungle
prompt: A tall waterfall pours into a deep green pool in a dense tropical jungle, mist rising with a faint rainbow in the sunlight. Camera: drone starts low over the pool and rises slowly up the face of the waterfall to reveal the jungle canopy stretching to distant mountains. Lush green, bright soft light. Sound: roaring water, birds, insects. Nature documentary, 4K look.

title: Northern lights over a lake
prompt: Timelapse of bright green and violet northern lights dancing over a frozen lake surrounded by snowy pine trees and mountains, stars moving slowly across the sky, the aurora reflected on patches of clear ice. A small red cabin with a lit window on the shore. Camera: static wide shot on a tripod. Sound: soft wind, distant cracking ice. Calm, majestic.

title: Ocean wave in slow motion
prompt: Low angle from the water's surface: a turquoise ocean wave curls and breaks in slow motion, sunlight shining through the thin lip of the wave, spray glittering in the air. Camera: static, almost at water level. Sound: deep wave crash, then a soft hiss. Calm, hypnotic, nature b-roll.

title: Foggy forest at sunrise
prompt: A quiet pine forest at sunrise filled with soft fog, golden sunbeams breaking through the trees in visible rays, dew on ferns on the forest floor. Camera: slow smooth glide forward between the trunks at eye level. Muted greens and warm gold. Sound: birdsong, a light breeze, a distant woodpecker. Peaceful, cinematic nature b-roll.

title: Hummingbird at a flower
prompt: Macro slow-motion shot of a shimmering green hummingbird hovering in front of a bright red trumpet flower, wings a soft blur, then dipping its beak into the flower. Background a creamy blur of garden greens. Camera: static macro, shallow depth of field. Soft morning light catching the iridescent feathers. Sound: wing hum, soft garden ambience. Wildlife documentary.
